title: 8 Engagement Ring Cuts and the Hands They Flatter
audience: Couples in their 30s, affluent, interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences beyond that, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: Fast mode: 02, 03 and 04 in parallel after the brief; 5 SERP cities; editor and readers in parallel; one combined final pass.

Hands they flatter: each 'flatters' line only where GIA or a jewellery-education source supports it; otherwise describe what the shape does visually and say 'try it on'. Gender-neutral, body-neutral ('the wearer', 'longer or shorter fingers'); never framed as fixing a flaw.
Default 8: round brilliant, oval, emerald, cushion, princess, pear, marquise, radiant (swap one, e.g. Asscher, if search demand says so).
Overlap: link the diamond buying guide (shape and grading), ring styles (overall looks), settings (how the stone is held), celebrity rings (real examples). Don't repeat them.
Reuse and re-check GIA facts from content/posts/diamond-buying-guide/03-source-pack.json and content/posts/engagement-ring-styles/03-source-pack.json.
Firecrawl likely out of credits: use DataForSEO on_page_instant_pages, Apify web-fetch or search summaries, and record which.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices; no jeweller names; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred.
